# The Elephant In The Court Room

Official website for The Elephant In The Court Room legal advocacy campaign.

## Purpose

This website documents an ongoing legal dispute involving a lease-to-own agreement in Florida. It provides official information about the case, public court documents, videos, photographs, campaign updates, and opportunities to support the legal effort through crowdfunding.

## Primary Topics

- Legal advocacy
- Contract law
- Lease-to-own agreements
- Specific performance
- Civil litigation
- Florida courts
- Public awareness
- Crowdfunding

## Main Sections

- Home — Overview of The Elephant In The Court Room campaign and its purpose.
- About — Background and story of the campaign and the people involved.
- Case — Information about the legal dispute, case history, and timeline.
- Updates — Campaign and case-related updates.
- Videos — Campaign documentary and video materials.
- Photos — Photographs documenting the property and campaign story.
- Documents — Public case documents and related records.
- Downloads — Downloadable case documents and campaign materials.
- Contact — Contact information and ways to support or share the campaign.
- Privacy — Privacy Policy governing use of the website.
- Terms — Terms of Service governing use of the website.
- Disclaimer — Important legal, fundraising, and website-use disclaimers.
